verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: How an Aussie 'battle taxi' invention spread around the world
title.zh: 澳大利亚的“战斗出租车”发明如何传播到世界各地

summary.en: Australia is investing $750 million to build more Bushmasters — but what makes them so desirable on the battleground?
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。
